stableOracle.reason: The pinned stable tree predates the baseline's focused CodeCellView extraction; stable-only behavior remains covered by its owning older renderer and the enumerated stable-fix queue.

nativeAdaptation.renderingAuthority: Final renderer-neutral colored runs are projected directly into Ratatui Line values; Ratatui's cell buffer is authoritative.
nativeAdaptation.wideGlyphs: OpenTUI capture associates the highlighted wide-glyph lead-cell style with an adjacent zero-width combining mark. The native test verifies identical text geometry and the style on Ratatui's wide-glyph lead cell; Ratatui reserves its continuation cell.
nativeAdaptation.caching: OpenTUI parsed-color and spacer object caches become owned immutable Rust colors and cheap deterministic spacer plans; derived theme colors retain the bounded caches in row_style.rs.
nativeAdaptation.paintOrder: Extension marks transform immutable source spans first. Cursor or copy paint then supplies the final background, after which deferred dim foregrounds resolve against that exact background.
